intro: How a film or a play is made, who does what, and how to give your opinion of what you have seen.
p.guion.consejo: It has no accent: it is a single syllable. The person who writes it is the «guionista».
p.rodar.consejo: The o becomes ue: «ruedo», «ruedas», «rueda». The past «rodó» does not change.
p.rodaje.consejo: It comes from «rodar». A shoot can last weeks or months, with many people working.
p.estreno.consejo: The verb is «estrenar»: «la película se estrena el viernes». You also «estrenas» a new suit.
p.banda sonora.consejo: It is feminine: «la banda sonora». It includes the music and the songs of the film.
p.decorado.consejo: It comes from «decorar». On screen it looks real, but it may be made of cardboard or wood.
p.vestuario.consejo: In a gym, «el vestuario» is where you change clothes. Here it is the clothing of the show.
p.papel.consejo: You say «hacer el papel de» or «interpretar un papel». It is also the paper you write on.
p.interpretar.consejo: An actor interprets a role and a musician, a song. The noun is «la interpretación».
p.reparto.consejo: It is also handing out things: «el reparto de pizzas». It comes from «repartir».
p.taquilla.consejo: The ll sounds like y: ta-KI-ya. An «éxito de taquilla» sells lots of tickets.
p.butaca.consejo: In the cinema each «butaca» has a number. It is also a comfortable armchair at home.
p.doblar.consejo: In Spain almost every foreign film is dubbed. It also means to fold: «doblar una carta».
p.versión original.consejo: On cinema listings it is written «VO»: «en versión original con subtítulos».
b1.texto:
**Making a film.** The scriptwriter writes the **guion** (script). The director picks the **reparto** (cast) and **rueda** (shoots) the film: the **rodaje** (shoot) lasts weeks or months. You need **decorados** (sets), **vestuario** (costumes), special effects and a **banda sonora** (soundtrack).

**Acting.** An actor **interpreta** (plays) a **papel** (role). The protagonist is the main character.

**Watching it.** The film **se estrena** (opens): the **estreno** is the premiere. Tickets are bought at the **taquilla** (box office) and each viewer sits in a **butaca** (seat). In Spain almost all films are **dobladas** (dubbed), but there is also **versión original** with subtitles.

**Giving an opinion.** «La película trata de…», «El guion es previsible», «Vale la pena verla». An «éxito de taquilla» is a film that sells many tickets.

**Note.** The word **guion** is written without an accent.
b2.f0.texto: What did you think of the film?
b2.f1.texto: The lead actress plays her role magnificently.
b2.f2.texto: I found the script too predictable.
b2.f3.texto: The soundtrack and the sets are stunning.
b2.f4.texto: They say the shoot lasted two years.
b2.f5.texto: I do not understand why they have dubbed it.
b2.f6.texto: In the original version it would gain a lot.
b2.f7.texto: Although it may not be a masterpiece, it has been a box-office hit.
b2.f8.texto: Next time we will choose seats in the back row.
b4.texto:
Besides talking about tomorrow, the future is used to **guess**:

- **About the present:** **Serán las diez** (I think it is ten o'clock).
- **About the past**, with **habrá** + participle: **El rodaje habrá durado meses** (I suppose the shoot lasted months).
- **To concede a point:** **No será una obra maestra, pero…** (I admit that perhaps it is not, but…).

In spoken language it is used a lot to give an opinion cautiously.
b4.e0.texto: The shoot must have lasted many months.
b4.e1.texto: It may not be a masterpiece.
b4.e2.texto: It must be ten o'clock now.
b5.f0.texto: In the village square, the spotlights turn the night into a cardboard day.
b5.f1.texto: The technicians carefully move the sets made of painted wood.
b5.f2.texto: The costumes smell of dust and recent rain.
b5.f3.texto: The director raises a hand and asks for silence with a gesture.
b5.f4.texto: On hearing the word «action», the actors set off among the spotlights like shadows.
b5.f5.texto: Months later, the premiere fills the hall of the old cinema on the avenue.
b5.f6.texto: At the box office, a long queue waits under the red lights of the sign.
b5.f7.texto: Inside, the velvet seats creak when the audience sits down.
b5.f8.texto: When the lights go out, the soundtrack fills the hall with slow music.
b5.f9.texto: At the end, the audience applauds standing for several minutes.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: the soundtrack is the music and songs of the film.
b6.o1.refuerzo: The cast is the group of actors, not the music.
b6.o2.refuerzo: The costumes are the actors' clothes.
b6.pregunta: What is the music of a film called?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «estrenarse» is opening in cinemas for the first time.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Rodar» is shooting the film; it is not showing it.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Doblar» is adding voices in another language.
b7.pregunta: Which verb means opening in cinemas for the first time?
b8.frase: La película se rodó en solo seis semanas
b8.traduccion: The film was shot in just six weeks
b9.o0.refuerzo: Writing the script is the scriptwriter's job.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Yes: playing a role is acting as a character.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Tickets are sold at the box office.
b9.pregunta: What does an actor who plays a role do?
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «the seat» (in the cinema).
b11.frase: Las entradas se compran en la ____.
b11.o0.refuerzo: The «butaca» is the seat you sit in, not where you pay.
b11.o1.refuerzo: The soundtrack is the film's music.
b11.o2.refuerzo: Yes: the «taquilla» is the window where tickets are bought.
b11.pregunta: Where do you buy the tickets?
b12.o0.refuerzo: It does not speak of tomorrow: it speaks of the time it is now.
b12.o1.refuerzo: It orders nothing: it only guesses a time.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Yes: it is a way of saying «creo que son las diez».
b12.pregunta: What does the future express in «Serán las diez»?
p.parecido.consejo: From «parecer», to seem. «Me ha parecido» means it seemed to me.
p.interpreta.consejo: In the theatre and cinema, an actor «interpreta» a role.
p.magnífica.consejo: Feminine of «magnífico». The tilde marks the stress on NI.
p.decorados.consejo: From «decorar». In a film, the «decorados» are built on purpose.
p.impresionantes.consejo: Plural of «impresionante». The ci sounds like «sy» in Spain.
p.duró.consejo: «Durar» is to last. The stress is on RO.
p.doblado.consejo: In Spain, «doblar» a film means to dub it into Spanish.
p.ganaría.consejo: The -ía ending is the conditional: «yo ganaría».
p.elegiremos.consejo: The g before e sounds like «h»: e-le-hi-RE-mos.
p.durado.consejo: With «habrá», it is the past participle: «habrá durado».
p.focos.consejo: The c before o sounds like «k»: FO-kos. «El foco» is masculine.
p.convierten.consejo: «Convertir» changes e to «ie» in the stress: convierto, convierten.
p.técnicos.consejo: The accent on the first syllable shows the stress: TEK-ni-kos.
p.gesto.consejo: The g before e sounds like «h»: KHES-to.
p.actores.consejo: «Actor» is used for men and women: «la actriz» is the feminine form.
p.echan.consejo: «Echar a andar» means to start walking.
p.andar.consejo: The stress is at the end: an-DAR. Also means «to work» as a machine.
p.letrero.consejo: Its family is «letra», letter. A sign is a piece of letters.
p.terciopelo.consejo: The c before i sounds like «th». Masculine: «el terciopelo».
p.crujen.consejo: The j sounds like a strong «h»: KRU-jen.
p.apagan.consejo: The opposite of «encender», to turn on.
p.aplaude.consejo: The au is one diphthong: a-PLAU-de.
p.pie.consejo: «De pie» means standing up. The word is short: PYE.
p.estrena.consejo: «Estrenar» is to use or show something for the first time.
p.rodó.consejo: «Rodar» means to film a movie. Stress on DO.
p.actúa.consejo: «Actuar» can mean to act on stage or simply to behave.
p.suposición.consejo: From «suponer», to suppose. The -ción ending is always feminine.
